title: Evidence Hub: Lightweight Competitor Radar for Model Landscape
creator: Jamal Rivera
description: Build a lightweight, repeatable playbook and minimal product surface (Evidence Hub) to continuously collect, score, and prioritize marketplace signals about open models and competitor endpoints. The goal is to produce a low-friction pipeline for PMs and scouts to capture evidence (benchmarks, pricing, availability, quantization/compatibility notes) and surface a sortable radar/dashboard in Console and the Model Sourcing doc. This ticket scopes the MVP: data schema, score rubric, ingestion UI wireframe, a stored table of canonical evidence, and an export to the Model Prioritization board.
acceptance_criteria: Schema defined and documented in Confluence with example entries (latency, token-cost, quantization, license, region availability)
Ingestion UI prototype (Figma) linked and reviewed by Design with actionable feedback incorporated
ETL script + GitHub PR that pulls two public model sources and normalizes into canonical rows (unit-tested)
Radar dashboard mock in Console with filters for region, priority, and recent changes
Hand-off doc and runbook so PMs can onboard new scouts and add evidence without Eng support

decisions: Keep MVP read-only for automated feeds and limited manual entries to reduce scope and moderation needs.
Use numeric canonical fields (latency_ms, cost_per_1k_tokens_usd, quant_support boolean, license_tier) to make filtering/sorting predictable.
Weighting for model-priority score: latency 35%, cost 25%, enterprise-fit 25%, freshness 15% (subject to revision after pilot).
Expose CSV export and a Console read-only radar; alerts/baseline drift detection deferred to follow-up ticket.
